newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand says Brunei buys 33,000 tonnes rice.
newsitem.headline: Thailand says Brunei buys 33,000 tonnes rice.

text.p: BANGKOK, Nov 4 (Rueter) - Brunei has agreed to buy 33,000 tonnes of high quality rice from Thai government for 1997 delivery, a commerce ministry official said Monday.
The amount was 6,000 tonnes more than the country bought from Thailand last year, the official said. But price details were unavailable.
The purchase included 21,600 tonnes of 100 percent fragrant rice, 7,200 tonnes of 100 percent grade rice and 4,200 tonnes of glutinous rice, she said.
